results.title: Robo.ai’s Alif Holding signals a new push into Sovereign AI and critical infrastructure
results.description: ABU DHABI, UAE — The appointment of former INTERPOL President H.E. Dr. Ahmed Naser Al-Raisi as Chairman of Alif Holding marks more than a change at the top of the Abu Dhabi-based technology group. It signals a broader ambition by Robo.ai Inc. to position its proposed subsidiary at the intersection of artificial intelligence, industrial technology,
